declaration: TASK75B_DATASET_BASIS + DEVELOPMENT_CORPORATE_ACTION_SURVIVAL_V1 (pre-registered BEFORE any ALL-adjusted outcome exists)

dataset_basis.symbols: the frozen 35 (research/task75_v1/contracts.py::UNIVERSE) + SPY, IDENTICAL parameters for every symbol (SPY is downloaded in the same request stream, never from a separate/older directory)
dataset_basis.windows_source: results/task74_alpha_discovery_v2/development_data_manifest.json (authoritative; four slices -- the task text listed three)
dataset_basis.query_bounds: each window from its start 00:00 ET to its end 23:59:59 ET (UTC-converted), all sessions incl. extended hours exactly as returned; the frozen evaluator itself restricts to the regular session
dataset_basis.excluded: VALIDATION 2024-06-01..2024-09-02 and REPLICATION 2024-10-21..2024-12-20 are NOT downloaded (guard at DOWNLOAD and LOAD layers, state PREFLIGHT)
dataset_basis.authority: ALL adjustment is download-date dependent (proven: provider_semantics.json -- later dividends re-scale earlier prices). The ARCHIVED BYTES and their sha256 hashes are authoritative; a later re-download with the same parameters is NOT claimed identical.

why_all: the frozen contract records RAW because RAW was the original discovery dataset -- that field is provenance and is NOT edited (research/task75_v1/contracts.py unchanged; both fingerprints unchanged)
Task75A explicitly BLOCKED validation on RAW (corporate_action_policy.json)
the Task75A handoff authorises adjustment=split OR adjustment=all as the corporate-action remediation

Task75 has no explicit dividend cash accounting for a SHORT (it owes dividends to the lender); ALL neutralises dividend price drops -- the corporate-action-safe basis. SPLIT would leave dividend drops in price as an unearned short gain.

the DEVELOPMENT audit (corporate_action_audit.json) shows real in-window events: KLAC 10:1 split 2026-06-12, NFLX 10:1 split 2025-11-17, HON spin-off / 1:2 event 2026-06-29, 61 cash dividends (incl. SPY)
known_before_registration: The RAW DEVELOPMENT ledger (already-existing evidence) contains two KLAC shorts spanning the unadjusted 10:1 split (+88.21 % and +88.40 % gross; ~176.6 of ~607 total gross percentage points). This is a property of the RAW data, disclosed here; NO ALL-adjusted outcome has been computed. The gate below is the task's own, unchanged.

survival_rule.evaluator: research/task75_v1/strategy.py::evaluate() UNMODIFIED, run per development slice, data_ready trades concatenated -- identical to the RAW anchor procedure (gross, pre-stop, exactly as the anchor was defined)

gates_all_required.C: symbol-cluster GROSS bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 under BOTH (i) the ORIGINAL anchor call research.task71_lib.diagnostics.cell_summary -> bootstrap_ci_clustered(n_resamples=2000, seed=670067, 95 %) AND (ii) bootstrap_ci_clustered(n_resamples=10000, ci_level=0.95, seed=670067), grouping = symbol
gates_all_required.D: entry-day-cluster GROSS bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 under BOTH (i) the original call (day_col=decision_day, which must be verified bijective with entry_day) AND (ii) 10,000 resamples grouped by entry_day
gates_all_required.G: RAW vs ALL trade diff has UNEXPLAINED == 0

survival_rule.resample_resolution: The recorded anchor CIs were produced with 2000 resamples (verified bit-exact), while the task specifies 10,000. Both are REQUIRED to pass -- the stricter of the two binds. Neither is chosen after seeing results.
survival_rule.no_discretion: A day-cluster lower bound of 0 or below under either call FAILS, however small the miss.

classification.TASK75B_READY: fingerprints match AND raw parity PASS AND semantics proven AND ALL development dataset complete AND all gates pass AND unexplained == 0 AND validation/replication untouched

survival_rule.after_ready: STOP -- validation is NOT downloaded or run in this task; explicit operator authorisation required
